;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020)]]
**The [[Syrian Army]], backed by [[Russian Air Force]] support, enters the largely deserted city of [[Ma'arrat al-Nu'man]] in the northern [[Idlib Governorate]]. Only light resistance is reported as most rebel groups, including [[Hayat Tahrir al-Sham]], withdrew their fighters. The city had been under rebel control since October 2012. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/pro-government-forces-enter-syrian-rebel-town-maaret-al-numan (''Middle East Eye'')]

;Business and economy
*The [[Barakah nuclear power plant]] in the [[United Arab Emirates]], the first commercial [[nuclear plant]] in the [[Arab world]], is declared ready for operation after years of delays. It is expected to go online sometime during this quarter. [https://www.reuters.com/article/emirates-energy-nuclearpower-idAFL8N29X4CQ (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Caribbean earthquake]]
**A magnitude 7.7 [[earthquake]] is recorded off the coast of [[Jamaica]]. [https://www.kron4.com/news/world/7-3-magnitude-earthquake-hits-near-jamaica/ (KRON 4 News)]
*Three people, including former Mayor [[Frank Edwards (Illinois politician)|Frank Edwards]] and his wife Cinda, are killed in a plane crash near [[Springfield, Illinois]], United States. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/small-plane-crash-illinois-kills-people-dog-onboard/story?id=68607922 (ABC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Palau]]'s [[President of Palau|President]] [[Thomas Remengesau Jr.]] bans [[chartered flight]]s from [[People's Republic of China|China]] and suspends charter flights from [[Macau]] and [[Hong Kong]] until further notice. Remengesau is set to issue an executive order to that effect after a meeting with the National Emergency Committee. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/408269/two-men-in-quarantine-in-samoa-over-coronavirus-fears (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mainland China]]
***The Health Commission in the central [[China|Chinese]] province of [[Hubei]] say there are 1,291 new confirmed cases of [[Novel coronavirus (2019-nCoV)|novel coronavirus (2019-nCoV)]] and 24 more deaths, bringing the total death toll to 106 people. [https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2020/01/560268/china-virus-death-toll-jumps-106-nearly-1300-new-cases (AFP via ''New Straits Times'')]
***[[China]]'s [[paramount leader]] [[Xi Jinping]] tells the [[World Health Organization]] he is confident about defeating the "devil virus". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-health/chinas-xi-tells-who-hes-confident-of-slaying-devil-virus-idUSKBN1ZR0CF (Reuters)] 

;Law and crime
*Prosecutor General of [[Tajikistan]], Yusuf Rakhmon, announces the arrest of 113 alleged members of the [[Muslim Brotherhood]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tajikistan-islamist/tajikistan-arrests-113-alleged-muslim-brotherhood-members-idUSKBN1ZR1C5 (Reuters)]
*[[Investigations involving Benjamin Netanyahu]]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] withdraws a request for [[Legal immunity|immunity]] to the [[Knesset]]. [[Attorney General of Israel|Attorney General]] [[Avichai Mandelblit]] formally indicts Netanyahu on charges of [[bribery]], [[fraud]], and [[Civil wrong|breach of trust]] in three cases of suspected [[corruption]]. [https://www.vox.com/2020/1/28/21111500/israeli-prime-minister-benjamin-netanyahu-corruption-trump-peace-plan (Vox)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 New Zealand general election]]
**[[Prime Minister of New Zealand|Prime Minister]] [[Jacinda Ardern]] announces that the next general election is to be held on September 19. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jan/28/new-zealand-election-jacinda-ardern-sets-september-date-for-poll (''The Guardian'')]

*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]], [[2020 Trump Israel–Palestine plan|Trump peace plan]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] unveil a peace plan developed by the Trump administration for three years. The plan recognizes Israeli sovereignty over major settlement blocs in the [[Israeli occupation of the West Bank|occupied]] [[West Bank]], as well as the [[annexation of the Jordan Valley]], in exchange for a freeze on new Israeli settlements in certain areas for four years. [[President of Palestine|Palestinian President]] [[Mahmoud Abbas]] dismisses the plan as "nonsense", while Israeli opposition leader [[Benny Gantz]] casts his support for the plan. [https://apnews.com/f7d36b9023309ce4b1e423b02abf52c6 (Associated Press)]
*[[Politics of Qatar]]
**[[Khalid bin Khalifa bin Abdul Aziz Al Thani|Sheik Khalid bin Khalifa]], aide of the [[Emir of Qatar|Emir]], is appointed [[Prime Minister of Qatar|Prime Minister]], succeeding [[Abdullah bin Nasser bin Khalifa Al Thani|Abdullah bin Nasser]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-qatar-politics-idUSKBN1ZR0PY (Reuters)]
